name: dnd-app-v2
description: Locally-hosted real-time D&D virtual tabletop with separate DM and player views, exposed remotely via Cloudflare Tunnel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client

comments.overrides: Force the patched shell-quote (>=1.8.4, GHSA-w7jw-789q-3m8p) into concurrently's tree — concurrently still resolves the vulnerable 1.8.3 and `npm audit fix` won't bump it. It's a patch release, so API-compatible.
